description: Defines the MaybeRenderEarlyManager class for speculative image rendering in media GPU Android context, including methods for setting surface bundles, adding codec images, and rendering early. Also includes internal template function for rendering logic.

classes.name: MaybeRenderEarlyManager
classes.description: Manages speculative rendering of media images, attempting to advance images to front/back buffers when possible.

methods.name: SetSurfaceBundle
methods.description: Sets the surface bundle for future images.

methods.name: AddCodecImage
methods.description: Adds a codec image holder and attempts early rendering.

methods.name: MaybeRenderEarly
methods.description: Performs early rendering of codec images.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a default instance of MaybeRenderEarlyManager using a GPU task runner and lock.
